rationale: The original thesis of a coil on the 5-minute 9-EMA ($29.13) with higher lows has broken down, as price rejected the EMA and is now making lower lows down to $29.00 on the 1-minute chart. With the broader market weak (SPY -1.54%, VIXY +8.88%) and upward momentum stalling, exiting at $29.02 for a negligible loss preserves capital rather than waiting for the $28.95 invalidation to trigger. Because HPQ remains well above its $28.67 session VWAP in the top quartile of its daily range, flipping short here offers poor risk-reward.
